alt: Whole-body circulatory system with every major artery and vein labeled in English. Color-coded: arteries red, veins blue. Includes carotid + vertebral + brachiocephalic at the head; aorta + IVC + SVC at the heart; subclavian, axillary, brachial, radial, ulnar in upper limb; common iliac, femoral, popliteal, saphenous in lower limb; hepatic portal + celiac + mesenteric + renal in the trunk.
